title: Derivative of an extended sign restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs on all coordinates outside $J$. If $i\in J$, then at every cube point $x$, the discrete derivative in coordinate $i$ of the function obtained by extending this restriction agrees with the discrete derivative of $f$ at the point formed from the coordinates of $x$ in $J$ and the fixed signs outside $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $z$ assigns a sign to every coordinate outside $J$
